name: flame.web/browse.v1
description: Read a bounded page of a previously captured snapshot by ID and Unicode codepoint offset. This reads captured material without network I/O; an evicted snapshot is refused.

name: flame.web/fetch.v1
description: Fetch a URL through configured Jina Reader credentials and capture a private immutable snapshot. Return its first 8192 Unicode codepoints and exact continuation offset.

name: flame.web/request.v1
description: Execute one HTTP request within the installed host allowlist. GET and HEAD are allowed; other methods are refused. Responses are bounded to 256 KiB. Preserve the command identity: an unconfirmed request must never be resubmitted.

name: flame.web/search.v1
description: Search through configured Tavily credentials with a query up to 8192 bytes, honoring explicit domain and supported recency filters. Each call queries the provider; results are bounded to 128 KiB.
